title: Telemetry
intro: The hub's live data stream: to this app and other receivers.
leanHint: Lean: realtime values only; energy and money are read on demand — less load on the hub.
fullHint: Full: every frame carries realtime values plus energy and money.
switchFailed: Could not switch the profile (no connection, or an admin token is needed).
firmwareOwned: State and technical parameters are set by the firmware; only the profile is changed here.
